`imageUrl` must be a photo you just uploaded via `POST /api/uploads`
and haven't attached to anything else (it is deleted from the server
when the story expires). Target one group (`groupId`), several
(`groupIds`, cross-posting), or one group narrowed to a circle
(`groupId` + `circleId`). Every target group must have
`storiesEnabled`. The story expires 24 hours after creation.
